name: X-Man Tornado V3 3x3 Premium (Standard)
description: Introducing the X-Man Tornado V3 3x3 Premium (Standard) — the latest evolution of a legendary flagship loved by speedcubers worldwide. This premium upgrade brings all the iconic performance and innovation of the original Tornado V3, elevated with new features designed for a next-level solving experience. What sets the Premium edition apart?
features: Reinforced Integrated Core for enhanced strength, drastically reducing the risk of core breakage and magnet loss.
Magnet system embedded securely within the spherical core shell, creating a unified, consistent turning feel across all faces.
